svg.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B W8A8 single-chip SWE concurrency speed-throughput tradeoff
svg.desc: Only client concurrency changes within the single-chip W8A8 real-MTP2 series. Every point is one 900s closed-loop observation on one Ascend 910B3 chip at max-num-seqs 16.

g.text: W8A8 + real MTP2 · int8 W/A · bf16 KV
P90 request decode speed · output tokens/s
The line connects all five measured client C levels (C1/C2/C4/C8/C16); it is not a fitted curve or a cross-setting Pareto envelope.

One server instance per line; max-num-seqs 16 equals the C16 offered load, so C16 is the saturation seat count, not beyond-capacity. On this single chip the C8 peak is followed by a measured C16 collapse: the KV budget fits only 3.07 lanes at 262144 tokens, so the C16 prompt stream evicts prefix reuse. W8A8 vs BF16 differs in precision, so no cross-precision speedup claim.
